That Rampal Police investigated the case and after completion of the investigation submitted charge sheet being No.124 dated 30/1/2001 under sections 143/302/31 of the Penal Code against the condemned-prisoner's along with 59 persons of whom 52 are the FIR named accused’s and that out of them 7 accused persons were arrested where their name were not mentioned in the F.I.R. 

 49. P.W.15 Md. Nasiruddin is Officer-in-Charge of Ramps Police Station. He was a subsequent investigating officer of the case.
